newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian shares end weak in rudderless trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian shares end weak in rudderless trade.

text.p: ** (1215 GMT) Indian blue chips close subdued as foreign
funds stay away on political concerns -- traders
** Bombay top-30 share index ends 37.60 points, or 0.89
** Share prices still in technical correction, trade mostly
** Delhi share index off 19.90 pts at 878.68, Madras dips
44.77 pts at 42,41.11; Calcutta up 0.80 pts at 130.89
** National exchange index manages to stay in positive
terrain, up 0.20 points at 1183.55, in new account
** Indian stocks almost fully valued, little further rise
seen, Soc-Gen Crosby India economist says
